aviation_incidents.headline: 塞爾維亞空軍MiG-29戰機墜毀 飛行員罹難
aviation_incidents.summary: 塞爾維亞國防部表示，該國空軍與防空部隊一架MiG-29戰鬥機於2026年11月17日在貝爾格勒西北方的Stara Pazova附近墜毀，飛行員Goran Bulajić少校罹難。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Serbian Air Force MiG-29 crashes, killing pilot
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Serbia’s Ministry of Defense said a Serbian Air Force and Air Defense MiG-29 fighter crashed on November 17, 2026, near Stara Pazova, northwest of Belgrade, killing its pilot, Major Goran Bulajić.

aviation_incidents.headline: 英國航空787-10客機滑出滑行道受困草地、拉各斯航班取消
aviation_incidents.summary: 英國航空一架波音787-10夢幻客機17日上午在倫敦希斯洛機場滑行時衝出滑行道。該機執飛前往奈及利亞拉各斯的BA75航班，約上午10時30分由5號航站C衛星樓登機門後推，前往27L跑道途中錯過轉彎而受困。據航班追蹤資料，飛機於當地時間上午10時45分左右未能完成預定轉彎，以約5節（每小時9.3公里）的速度滑行時，前輪陷入泥地，停在27L跑道西端、5B與5C衛星樓之間的草地上，數小時後仍受困於原地。事故原因目前仍不明。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: British Airways Boeing 787-10 veers off taxiway at Heathrow, stuck in mud
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A British Airways Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner has suffered a taxiway excursion at London Heathrow Airport (LHR). The widebody twinjet had pushed back from its gate at the airport's satellite Terminal 5C and was on its way to runway 27L ahead of its planned departure to Murtala Muhammed International Airport (LOS) in Lagos, Nigeria, as BA75. However, it missed a turn and got stuck. Several hours later, the aircraft remained beached in the grass at the western end of runway 27L between satellite terminals 5B and 5C. British Airways has confirmed that it is working to get the passengers of flight BA75 on their way again, but the return leg has been canceled as a result of the excursion.

taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空宣佈，規劃在2027年3月23日開航臺北－雪梨－奧克蘭新航線。這將是星宇航空成立以來，首次將航網延伸至大洋洲。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: STARLUX Airlines plans Taipei–Sydney–Auckland service for March 2027

international_aviation.headline: 聯合航空系統故障 全美主線航班停飛 問題已排除
international_aviation.summary: 聯合航空11月16日週一晚間發生系統故障，導致全美主線出發航班全面停飛；已在空中的航班與聯合快運（United Express）航班不受影響。故障原因是系統無法計算飛機的重量與平衡，飛機因此滯留於登機門，數千名旅客行程延誤。問題隨後已排除，航班可恢復出發，但晚間仍可能出現延誤。
international_aviation.headline_en: United Airlines system outage grounds mainline flights nationwide; issue resolved
international_aviation.summary_en: United Airlines suffered a system outage on Monday evening, November 16, grounding all departing mainline flights nationwide. Flights already airborne and those operated by United Express were not affected. The outage left the airline unable to calculate aircraft weight and balance, keeping aircraft at the gate and delaying thousands of passengers across the network. The system has since been resolved, and flights are able to depart, though delays were expected through the rest of the evening.

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空509座A380最後4條航線出爐、12月17日飛完最後一班
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空是少數仍在營運空中巴士A380的航空公司之一。根據ch-aviation資料，這家德國籍航空目前擁有8架A380-800，並計畫讓該機型服役至2030年代。漢莎的A380有509座與499座兩種布局，據AeroRoutes報導，509座布局將於下月停用。根據aeroLOPA資料，509座布局設有8間頭等套房、78個2-2-2排列的商務艙座位、53個特選經濟艙座位與371個經濟艙座位。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa to end 509-seat Airbus A380 operations, final flight on December 17
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa is one of the few airlines that continue to operate the Airbus A380. According to ch-aviation, the German flag carrier currently has a fleet of eight A380-800s and plans to keep the aircraft in service well into the 2030s. The airline operates the double-deckers in two configurations, offering either 509 or 499 seats, but as reported by AeroRoutes, it is planning to end operations with its 509-seat A380s next month. The 509-seat layout features eight first-class suites, 78 business-class seats arranged in a 2-2-2 configuration, 53 premium economy seats and 371 economy seats, according to aeroLOPA.
